sentences.text:
Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay, Mr. Aniruddha Sen.
... for the appellant.

Mr. Indranath Mukherjee, Mr. Pradip Kumar Neogi, Mr. Sakti Prasad Chakraborty, Mr. Asish Dutta.
... for the respondent.

Re: CAN 1 of 2022 This is an application for condonation of delay of 275 days in preferring the instant appeal assailing an order of the Land Acquisition Court enhancing the compensation to the respondent in relation to a land acquired under Act-I of 1894.
However, the Stamp Reporter has indicated that there is a delay of 208 days in preferring the instant appeal.
We do not want to go into the veracity of the length of delay, the moment the respondent candidly submits that he has no objection if the instant application is allowed.
In view of the above, the instant application is allowed on consent.
The delay in preferring the appeal is hereby condoned.
The office is directed to formally register the appeal.
Let the application for stay being CAN 2 of 2023 be listed on 11th December 2023.

(Harish Tandon, J.) (Madhuresh Prasad, J.)
